dimensions.name: Personification
dimensions.primary_construct: separate identity, singular self-reference, and ownership of personal opinions

dimensions.name: Register
dimensions.primary_construct: power dynamic between agent and user
dimensions.status: partly effective; Peer overlaps Advisor without genuine shared work

dimensions.name: Formality
dimensions.status: directional positive; separable from Register with confidence invariant

dimensions.name: Warmth
dimensions.status: directional positive; interaction requires an independent routine cue

dimensions.name: Personality Intensity
dimensions.status: directional positive with task-response cue; personification markers excluded from evidence; figurative/signature cues require a bounded semantic job under bundle pressure

dimensions.name: Reading Level
dimensions.primary_construct: density of domain terminology and specifications
dimensions.status: partly effective; explicit terminology-density cue needed, source terms can mask level, and factual attribution is shared with agent-design policy

dimensions.name: Emotional Coloring
dimensions.primary_construct: default evaluative framing of events and outcomes
dimensions.status: partly effective; non-Neutral cues required, compound-position leakage documented, and Clinical with Playful has a cross-fixture non-blocking instruction-competition warning

dimensions.name: Empathy Level
dimensions.status: directional positive; expressed-impact cue separable from Warmth; reassurance about blame, competence, causality, or controllability remains evidence-bound

dimensions.name: Brevity
dimensions.status: directional positive; separable from Reading Level while glossing policy stays fixed

dimensions.name: Humor
dimensions.status: directional positive; Playful cue and high-stakes suppression observed; Clinical interaction remains a cross-fixture non-blocking warning

dimensions.name: Emoji
dimensions.status: directional positive after observable vocabulary and cadence

dimensions.name: Punctuation
dimensions.status: directional positive after observable pattern and cadence

dimensions.name: Capitalization
dimensions.status: conditional weak; protected casing may mask behavior

components.name: Radio test
components.status: retain; behaviorally defined and directionally validated

components.name: Tone Boundaries
components.status: retain conditionally; pair plausible drift with preferred behavior

components.name: Tone Flex
components.ownership: Persona owns semantic and lexical policy; voice-ux owns voice-channel prosodic realization
components.status: retain; observable lexical/discourse cues and reset conditions directionally validated

components.name: Conversation progression handoff
components.status: owned by conversation-design; no universal Persona rule

components.name: Phrase Book
components.status: retain; varied palette directionally validated; figurative/signature cues need bounded semantic jobs

components.name: Never-Say List
components.status: retain; exact anti-phrases and controlled boundary calibration validated; runtime proof handed to agentforce-test

components.name: Lexicon
components.status: retain; definitions and stable meaning validated

components.name: Technical Explanation Policy
components.status: retain conditionally as rhetorical framing only; factual support and evidence policy hand off to agent design

components.name: Guardrails
components.status: retain as agent-design-adjacent; content boundary validated

components.name: Static-copy candidates
components.status: retain as Persona wording candidates; canonical authoring owner maps and validates them

components.name: Per-subagent calibration
components.conditional: canonical inspection returns an existing subagent and a demonstrated local character need
components.status: retain as an approved semantic delta; canonical authoring owner applies it

components.name: Action progress wording candidate
components.conditional: canonical inspection returns a progress-copy surface
components.ownership: agentforce-generate validates state honesty and applies the candidate
components.status: Persona may suggest wording but does not inspect or mutate the action

encoding.agent_script_owner: agentforce-generate or the active Agent Script authoring tool
encoding.voice_policy: Persona owns character and lexical Tone Flex; voice-ux owns spoken adaptation, prosody, and the Vocal Identity brief, casting, and light tuning; existing voice-ux implementation scope is unchanged
encoding.brownfield_invariant: Persona emits only approved semantic character deltas; the canonical Agent Script owner inspects, mutates, verifies, and validates source
encoding.content_contract_invariant: Persona exports expression-only acceptance criteria to conversation-design and agentforce-test; it does not claim runtime proof
